label: Is every board really solvable without guessing?
text: Yes. Every board in every mode is verified by a solver before it is shown to you.

label: Is the daily board the same for everyone?
text: Yes. All players worldwide receive the identical board each day (based on your local calendar date).

label: How do I remove ads?
text: Home → Settings → Remove Ads (one-time purchase). Use "Restore Purchases" on a new device.
